quests.title: Yachimatahiko's Trial

dialogue.t: I am Uda of the Jibashiri. Hero of Sangonomiya, I acknowledge that you are worthy to take on this challenge.
I am in charge of the trial of "wisdom." Go forth and solve all the puzzles to return the Flames of the High Gate to their places.
It is not bravery that advances bereft of wisdom, but foolhardiness instead!
I will await your completion of the challenge at the Tower of the Three Realms above.
I am Uda of the Jibashiri. Unrelated people may not enter.
Go forth, hero of Sangonomiya, and take on the challenge!
Return all the Flames of the High Gate to their places.
I, Uda of the Jibashiri, acknowledge your great valor.
Indeed, you are both "extensive and meticulous" in your wisdom.
How can you tell a person's character from these trials?
To be honest, these words are praises that the Divine Priestess used to bestow upon skilled youths. They eventually came to be written on pennants at the Jibashiri headquarters.

quests.description: Accepting the trial, you prepare to go to The Narrows to search for The Emanant Skylight
